dna.prompt: karakter lelaki kantoran umur 25 dengan stelan formal
dna.name: Office Formal Man

equipment.body: formal office suit with white dress shirt, dark navy blazer, and red tie
equipment.legs: matching dark navy dress trousers with black leather shoes

directions.up: Top-down back sprite of a slim office man in a neat navy blazer, with short dark brown side-part hair visible above the collar. The shoulders are squared, the jacket hem falls cleanly, and the dark trousers taper to polished black shoes in a tidy chibi pixel silhouette.
directions.down: Top-down front sprite shows a fair-faced young man with almond brown eyes, short side-part hair, and a calm formal expression. His white shirt, red tie, and navy blazer are centered neatly, with a black belt at the waist, straight dress trousers, and glossy shoes below.
directions.left: Left-facing side profile sprite shows the man’s neat side-part hair, fair cheek, and slim jawline. The navy blazer hangs sharply over a white shirt and red tie, with one arm resting naturally at his side. His trousers are straight, ending in a black dress shoe.
directions.right: Right-facing side profile sprite mirrors the formal office look with short dark brown hair, fair skin, and a clean profile. The blazer edge, shirt collar, and red tie are visible in pixel detail, while the slim trousers and black shoe complete the tidy corporate silhouette.
